list.title: Outer Clients
list.description: Manage external application clients and prepare credentials for SDK access.

client.createDescription: Create a client only when you need a new business application to read FAQ data. The list remains the primary workspace.
client.createPanelDescription: Operators only need to fill in the display name, remark, and validity period. The platform generates client_id and the first key automatically.
client.createResultDescription: Copy the env block once and save it into the target application's local environment file before you leave this panel.
client.deleteClientDescription: Deleting this client will disable all of its keys. Confirm that you want to continue.
client.deleteClientPendingDescription: The client will be deleted when the countdown ends. You can undo before then.

detail.title: Client Detail
detail.description: Generate or rotate keys, inspect active key versions, and reveal one-time private keys for copy only.

client.generateKeyDescription: Generate a new key in the current runtime environment. The previous active key enters rotating status for a short grace window.
client.generatedKeyDescription: The private key can only be viewed in the current page state. Refresh, leave, or close this panel and it will disappear.
client.unsavedLeaveDescription: After leaving or closing this area, the private key will no longer be visible. Confirm that you have already saved it.
client.deleteClientDescription: Deleting this client will disable all of its keys. Confirm that you want to continue.
client.deleteActiveKeyDescription: This key is currently active. After deletion, this client may no longer be callable until a new key is issued.
client.deleteKeyDescription: Deleting this inactive key is permanent. Confirm that you want to continue.
client.deleteKeyPendingDescription: The active key will be deleted when the countdown ends. You can undo before then.
client.noKeys: No keys have been issued for this client yet.
client.rotatingGraceHint: Rotating keys remain valid until their grace expiry time.
